description: Sandbox: issue the ak_test_ key an agent uses to pay out from this wallet. The secret is shown ONCE — store it in a secret store or env var right away. Retrying with the same idempotency_key never shows it again.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.

name: xaalis_issue_agent_key
title: Issue an agent wallet key (sandbox)
